links.outcome: Dementia identification F1, sensitivity, PPV for RAG LLM versus rule-based and keyword-filtered LLM on same labeled data
links.effect: RAG LLM F1=0.933, sensitivity 91.1%, PPV 95.5%; rule-based F1=0.823; keyword-filtered LLM F1=0.903, sensitivity 91.7%, PPV 88.6%.
links.quote: The RAG-based classifier achieved the highest performance (F1=0.933, sensitivity=91.1%, PPV=95.5%) compared to rule-based (F1=0.823, sensitivity=81.1%, PPV=83.5%) and keyword-filtered LLM (F1=0.903, sensitivity=91.7%, PPV=88.6%).

unlisted_practices: Excluding structured ICD codes from the LLM input to improve phenotyping precision
Comparing embedding models, retrieval methods, and prompts to select the best classifier configuration

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM pipeline comparing standard keyword-filtered LLMs against a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for clinical phenotyping/chart review.
